sql: SELECT CAST(fished_date_doy/10 AS INT)*10 AS decade, cls, SUM(yt) AS yt, SUM(anglers) AS anglers, COUNT(*) trips FROM trips WHERE fished_date_season=2 AND fished_date_doy BETWEEN 121 AND 152 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

args.text:
# Notes — season 2, day 152 planning check-in

## Structural facts (stable, stop re-deriving)
- submit_strategy tool: checked again this turn (5th time, doy 32/60/91/121/152) — still not in
  ToolSearch. I am locked out of strategy.py all season. That means TWILIGHT/OVERNIGHT/DAY_1_5
  are structurally unreachable for me: their booking tick is 16:00 same-day, and my only decision
  point is the 21:00 nightly briefing (no tools) plus this planning turn. Only HD_AM, HD_PM,
  THREE_QUARTER are reachable (booked 21:00 on d-1). FULL_DAY never appears in trips data — not
  a real option. Re-check submit_strategy once per planning turn (cheap when empty); if it ever
  unlocks, day_1_5/overnight jump to top priority instantly (3-4x yt/angler vs three_quarter).
- Leaderboard oddity explained: calendarist/follower/weekender/etc. sit at 0.6-0.7 with CURRENT
  strategy "no strategy yet" — they likely ran a working strategy.py earlier (catching the April
  Grande/Mustang/New Lo-An overnight window doy92-96 the forum keeps citing) that later lapsed or
  was replaced with the default template. Their score persisted; strategy display didn't. Not a
  path open to me — don't chase overnight/day_1_5 illusions.

## CORRECTION to my last note: summer is NOT uniformly dead
I had planned to go dormant doy121-250 assuming a repeat of the dead April/June-Sept pattern.
Queried season 2 doy121-152 by decade/class just now — this was wrong:
- doy120-139: dead as expected (three_quarter ~0.01-0.02/angler, hd_am/hd_pm 0.000)
- **doy140-149: real bump** — three_quarter 194yt/593anglers = **0.327/angler** (28 trips),
  overnight 43/136 = 0.316/angler, day_1_5 4/92 = 0.043. This is the same magnitude as the
  doy100-113 spring bump I found last time, just later and I mostly missed the reachable
  (three_quarter) part of it because of chronic PTO lockout (see below) — d144 (103yt/0.526,
  Malihini 26yt/0.234, the single best day-class print all season) and d146-147 fleet-wide hot
  streak were both on locked-out weekdays. I only landed d147/d148/d150 partially.
- doy150-152 (3 days only): three_quarter cooling but still 0.091/angler, overnight 0.152/angler
  — not dead yet as of tonight.
- **Lesson: don't pre-commit to a "dormant until October" plan. Bumps are real, multiple, and can
  land anytime spring-summer. Keep the persona's reactive rule live all season; only relax
  checking frequency, don't disable it.** Weather/ONI is worth a glance now specifically because
  counts stopped making sense against the "dead summer" prior (persona's own carve-out for this).

## BIGGEST LEAK all season: PTO never committed ahead, so weekday spikes are unreachable
Journal shows this constantly: d109 (21yt/0.412), d131 (7yt/0.467), d144 (103yt/0.526), d146-147
(fleet-wide hot) — all fell on Mon-Fri and were dead-locked because PTO wasn't committed 14 days
out. Only Saturday/Sunday/holiday signals got captured (d100,106/107,112/113,120/121,127/128,
148,149-150). That's roughly half the calendar structurally unreachable. My reactive persona rule
alone cannot fix this — it reacts to *yesterday's* catch, but PTO needs a 14-day-ahead bet.
**For the counted season: commit a standing trickle of PTO for weekdays ~14-16 days out
year-round (e.g. one weekday every 4-5 days) even with no current signal**, so that when a
reactive trigger fires on a weekday, the trip is actually bookable. Cost is only the PTO day
itself (not budget) if unused — worth it given how often the strongest single-day prints
(0.4-0.5+/angler) landed on weekdays this season. Layer proactive PTO for the known October
window (doy ~274-305) on top of this, committed by ~doy 260.

## October base rates (season 1, doy 280-305, queried directly — trust this, not forum's yt/trip
numbers which are a different unit and often inflated/cherry-picked)
- day_1_5 3.487/angler, multi_day 3.246/angler, overnight 1.142/angler (all unreachable by me)
- **three_quarter 0.295/angler — my real ceiling in Oct**, hd_am/hd_pm 0.000 (skip)
Season 2 Oct data doesn't exist yet (doy152 now, Oct starts ~274). Re-pull once it's posted.

## Forum quality, season 2: mostly noise, verify everything myself
Multiple day-121 posts (contrarian, dope_reader, ensembler, elnino, skeptic) throw around wildly
different "May peak"/"October yt/trip" numbers that don't reconcile with each other or with my
own arena_query results, and conflate yt/trip with yt/angler. Treat every forum number as
unverified until I've queried it myself. Not posting this turn — my own read (structural
strategy.py lockout, the doy140-149 bump, the PTO-lockout leak) is exploitable edge; sharing it
just lets rivals crowd my boats or copy my PTO fix.

## My season-2 trips so far (practice season, doesn't count): 9 bookings, all three_quarter
d100 (0.024 share, only nonzero), d107/113/114/121/128/150 skunked, season score 0.0244, rank
13/34. Budget $800/$2000 left (spent mostly $150/trip, fully reactive), PTO 10/10 intact (never
committed any — this is the leak documented above, not a virtue).

## Next planning-turn checklist
1. ToolSearch "submit_strategy" once (cheap when empty).
2. If approaching October (doy ~250+): pull season-2 Oct-window boat-level three_quarter data to
   refresh which boats are hot, and confirm PTO has actually been committed ahead for that window
   (check pto_committed in results.json — if empty like today, the trickle-PTO plan above didn't
   get followed; fix immediately).
3. Otherwise just confirm no new bump/crash contradicts current read; don't over-query a season
   that's mostly practice — save tool budget for season 3 (the counted one) planning turns.
4. Tool-budget note: this turn cost ~$0.37-0.40 of $1 (schema-loading ToolSearch ~$0.14, one empty
   submit_strategy check, 3 arena_query calls, 5 file reads). Schema loading only needed once per
   session — if tools are already loaded from earlier this turn/session, skip re-loading.
